name: Coloplast
original_rationale: Chronic-care consumables; verified 6-8% organic every year 2018-25; base uses guidance midpoint 6% and normalised FCF; trades ~15x EV/EBITDAaL vs ~26x 10y median, so no re-rating is assumed. Risks: lowered 2030 ambition, Kerecis impairment, foundation control.
measurable_expectations: Reported EBIT margin recovers toward >=27% by FY27/28
Kerecis (wound biologics) grows >=20% with no further impairment

scenarios_local.base_growth_source: GUIDANCE-ANCHORED OVERRIDE: Company cut 2030 ambition to 5-7% organic and guided FY26/27 5-7% (3-Nov-2026); Q4 FY25/26 organic 5%. Midpoint used.

principal_risks: Margin reset from ~28% to ~25% and weak acquisition returns (Kerecis)
US reimbursement risks: DMEPOS competitive bidding and skin-substitute payment cuts
thesis_break_conditions: CMS competitive bidding implemented with >5% US price cuts
